title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator to Return With New Anime (First Look Revealed)
content: The Apothecary Diaries has been an absolute runaway hit ever since it made its TV anime adaptation debut a couple of years ago, and now the creator behind the franchise has a new anime on the way that fans will want to keep an eye out for.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Second Season Announced for 2027
content: The 12th and final episode of Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) ended with an announcement on Saturday that a second season is in production. The series director, Jin-koo Oh drew an illustrations to commemorate the announcement (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime Gets 2nd Season in 2027
content: The television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels ended its first season on Saturday with an announcement of a second season next year. Update: Crunchyroll announced it will stream the second season.
author: ANN

title: The Cat and the Dragon Season 2 Announced for 2027
content: The Cat and the Dragon ( Neko to Ryu ) is getting a second TV anime season, scheduled to air in 2027. The announcement came following the first season’s finale, which released on September 19, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dengeki Daisy Reveals Main Trailer, Key Visual and 4 New Cast Members Ahead of January 2027 Release
content: Dengeki Daisy anime revealed its first main trailer and key visual, four additional cast members, and a January 2027 release date. The anime will adapt the manga through its conclusion and stream on Crunchyroll. Two consecutive cours have been confirmed, meaning that the anime will run through Spring 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: You and I Are Polar Opposites Reveals Graduation Day Visual Ahead of Season 2 Finale
content: You and I Are Polar Opposites anime has revealed a new Graduation Day visual as Season 2 approaches its final episodes. The graduation ceremony will be featured in Episode 24, airing on September 27, followed by the series finale, Episode 25, on October 4.
author: Anime Corner

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Tops Weekly Summer Ranking for Second Time in a Row After Episode 12
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 topped the Summer 2026 weekly ranking for the second time in a row in Week 11 after its Episode 12 . The anime previously won after the “Turning Point 4” episode, where Rudeus from the future was introduced.
author: Anime Corner

title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Main Visual and January 9 Premiere Date
content: YAIBA: Samurai Legend Season 2, the Kaguya Arc , revealed the main anime visual and a January 9, 2027 premiere date. WIT STUDIO is handling the animation for the new adaptation of Gosho Aoyama’s manga, which released its first season last year.
author: Anime Corner

title: Tamil, Telugu Dubs of Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill Anime Stream on Muse India
content: The first anime season premiered by streaming exclusively in Japan on Amazon Prime Video and Hikari TV in January 2023. Muse Asia streamed the first season of the anime in India as it aired in Japan. The Muse India YouTube channel then streamed episodes of the anime with Hindi subtitles in roman script.
author: ANN

title: Indian Delivery Service Blinkit Launches Pokémon Promotional Packaging
content: The packages features 30 different Pokémon including: • Pikachu • Mewtwo • Bulbasaur • Machamp • Squirtle • Charizard • Psyduck • Meowth • Gengar • Jigglypuff • Snorlax • Articuno • Blastoise • Ditto • Arcanine Each package will have a monochrome image featuring a Pokémon with an accompanying Pokémon card-style text.
author: ANN
